verdict.summary: Teva regained Investment Grade ratings across all three agencies (Moody's Baa3 Stable, S&P & Fitch IG) in 2026 after paying down ~$12bn debt since 2019. Q3 2026 Adj EBITDA grew 7% YoY to $1.5bn as innovative brands (+33% YoY) offset generic Revlimid roll-off, cutting net leverage to 2.71x on a credible path to 2.0x by YE27. Refinanced ~$4.9bn notes extending avg maturity to 6.3 yrs.

positives: Full Rising-Star Investment Grade status regained in 2026 across Moody's (Baa3 Stable), S&P, and Fitch.
Mix shift driving margin expansion: Q3 2026 innovative brands surged +33% YoY (Austedo $751m, Ajovy $269m, Uzedy $85m), lifting non-GAAP GM to 58.7% and Adj EBITDA +7% YoY to $1.5bn.
Proven deleveraging: ~$12bn debt retired since 2019; 2.71x net leverage at 3Q26 targeting 2.0x by end-2027; avg maturity extended to 6.3 yrs via $4.9bn refinancing.
negatives: Generics & generic Revlimid headwinds trimmed Q3 2026 top line by 2% YoY.
Large absolute debt stack (~$16-17bn gross) requires sustained FCF conversion ($495m Q326) and opioid settlement cash outlays.
Israeli geopolitical risk backdrop (though revenues/ops are overwhelmingly US/EU global).

background.business_overview: Global specialty biopharmaceutical and world's largest generic drug manufacturer headquartered in Tel Aviv.
background.asset_perimeter: Global commercial & manufacturing footprint across US, Europe, and International markets; notes issued by Teva Finance subsidiaries guaranteed by parent.
background.ownership_governance: Widely held public company listed on NYSE and TASE.

recent_drivers: 03-Nov-26 (Q3 2026): Revenue $4.4bn (-2% YoY), Adj EBITDA $1.5bn (+7% YoY), FCF $495m, Net Leverage 2.71x (vs 3.11x YoY).
2026 Rating Milestones: Upgraded to Baa3 (Moody's) and IG at S&P/Fitch; refinanced ~$4.9bn senior notes, extending avg maturity to 6.3 yrs.

catalysts.impact: Confirms pace toward 2.0x YE27 net leverage target and Austedo peak trajectory.
Further IG spread compression on lower coupon refinancing.
